planSteps.description: Open https://app.kohlestate-ksa.online/login and switch to English.
Verify Sign in with Google is enabled and no awaiting-configuration message appears. Email and password login remain visible.
Click Sign in with Google. Do not enter any credentials or complete sign-in.
Verify the browser reaches accounts.google.com for Google sign-in without a provider-disabled or redirect mismatch error.

name: Enabled Google login opens Google sign-in
